events.title: Monthly Club Meeting – “Wearables for Wildlife: Behind the Scenes with the Evolution of Wildlife Telemetry Technologies”
events.description: Club Meeting – North Museum of Nature and Science, 400 College Ave, Lancaster, PA 17603 Presented by Club President Andy McGann Andy McGann grew up birding in Southcentral Pennsylvania and his early experiences ultimately led to a career in the field of Movement Ecology. His time in academia, non-profits, consulting, and ultimately to a wildlife telemetry tech company spanned a timeframe that saw the science advance from analog radio telemetry to “smart devices” with GPS, accelerometers, and global Internet connectivity. In his career, Andy combined his experiences in ornithology with his love of technology and appreciation for geography in order to help wildlife researchers and organizations around the world obtain the scientific information needed to help conserve some of the rarest birds we have left. Andy will discuss the evolution of the technology, the current state-of-the-art, and paint a picture of where we are going.
events.location: North Museum of Nature and Science, 400 College Ave, Lancaster, PA, 17603

events.title: Middle Creek Winter Bird Walk
events.description: This field trip offers a hands-on birding experience that will allow participants to explore Middle Creek’s winter landscape and observe the season’s local bird species while gaining insight into the process of counting birds for the Christmas Bird Count (CBC). Whether you’re a seasoned birder or new to birding and CBCs, this outing offers a unique opportunity to connect with nature and learn how birding data is collected in the field each year for this citizen-science survey. Pre-registration is required by 5 p.m the day prior for this offering. Contact Ted at tanicholsii@gmail.com or 717-856-3851 if you have questions or want to make a reservation to attend. IMPORTANT NOTE: Attendees must wear blaze orange for this field trip per new Pennsylvania Game Commission regulations requiring wear on Game Lands Oct. 1 through Jan. 31. Location: Middle Creek Wildlife Management Area Visitor Center, 100 Museum Road, Stevens, PA 17578 Contact: Ted Nichols, 717-856-3851 or tanicholsii@gmail.com.
